item.title: 2026-01-24 Lots of work on the blog
item.description: This morning we woke to news that one of Keldor’s uncles has died.
I was up way too long last night working on the places lived) part of my blog, so it was around 01:45 that I managed to get to sleep.

item.title: 09. San Antonio, Texas 1973-1976
item.description: This address I still have memorised: 8611 Falling Timber.

item.title: index
item.description: Places I Have Lived I started life as a “military brat”. Therefore, I have moved often over the years.

item.title: 01. Texas 1966 - 1967
item.description: My parents met in Washington DC, where mom, Norma Jean Tyyska, born 1940-12-19, had lived for six years, working as a secretary at the Pentagon.

item.title: 02. Road trips 1967
item.description: When I was a couple of months old mom and I left Texas and she took me home to her parent’s house on North Cemetery Road, in Ewen, where we stayed for a several months, during which we did additional road trips: to Pennsylvania to meet my dad’s mom and some of his siblings and my cousins (his dad di...

item.title: 03. Tachikawa, Japan 1967-1970
item.description: In Japan we lived on Tachikawa Air Force Base, and this is where my earliest memories formed. In Japan I went to Nursery School, and loved it.

item.title: 04. Visit Michigan and Pennsylvania 1970
item.description: In early summer of 1970, when I was around 3.5 years old Dad got his next orders, and it was time for my first move to Europe.
